mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 2.5% annually signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the unemployment rate and decline in payroll employment signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand and reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST declines in a late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO > 12-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE reading above 5.0% signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS is rising, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) signals an imminent economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when GDPC1 growth declines in a late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
